description: Round the selected edges. Name the edges with one of: edges (ids), query (FeatureScript), feature (every edge that feature made), all, or circular.

all.description: Select all edges of all solid bodies.

edges.description: Explicit deterministic edge ids, from onshape_get_edges.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

feature.description: Select every edge created by this feature id.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Fillet").

query.description: FeatureScript query, e.g. query = qCreatedBy(makeId("FID"), EntityType.EDGE);

radius_variable.description: Use a Part Studio variable for the radius.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_fillet
title: Fillet edges
